name: Indian Springs Plaza
demographics: Indian Springs Plaza serves the Montrose and Glendale communities, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area draws from the Crescenta Valley region, with shoppers typically ranging from young professionals to established families seeking convenient neighborhood retail. The center benefits from its proximity to the 210 freeway, capturing both local residents and commuters who value accessible shopping for everyday needs and services.
description: Indian Springs Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located at 2065 Verdugo Boulevard in the Montrose area of Glendale, California. Strategically positioned near the 210 freeway, this convenient retail destination has served the local community for years as a reliable hub for everyday shopping and services. The plaza features a practical mix of stores and businesses that cater to the daily needs of residents in the Crescenta Valley area. With a solid 4.3-star rating from over 230 reviews, shoppers consistently praise the helpful staff and quality of stores, though some note that parking can be tight during peak hours. The center's accessible location and diverse tenant mix make it a popular choice for locals seeking a quick shopping trip without the hassle of larger regional malls.
summary: Indian Springs Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping center in Montrose, California, offering a practical mix of stores and services near the 210 freeway. With a 4.3-star rating and helpful staff, it serves as a reliable retail destination for local residents seeking everyday shopping needs.
